content:
Apple TV today released the trailer for the second season of the German-language black comedy *Where's Wanda?*, with the new season set to return on October 21. Watch the trailer below.

*Where's Wanda?* returns on October 21

Nearly two years ago, *Where's Wanda?* premiered on Apple TV, telling the story of the Klatt family searching high and low for their missing daughter—Wanda, from whom the show takes its name.

Growing increasingly frustrated with the police's efforts to locate her, the Klatts decide to take matters into their own hands, unearthing plenty of dark secrets about their neighbours along the way.

The first season of *Where's Wanda?* ran for a total of eight episodes. The second season, returning on October 21, also runs for eight episodes, with a new instalment dropping every Wednesday from today through December 9.
